items.exampleEn: There is a noticeable change in the weather.

items.exampleZh: 那支損壞的手機還能用。

items.exampleEn: The birds flew outward in all directions from the tree.
items.exampleZh: 鳥群從樹上向四面八方飛出去。

items.exampleEn: The boys played dangerously close to the cliff.
items.exampleZh: 男孩們在離懸崖很近的地方危險地玩耍。

items.exampleEn: The children painted the farm animals vividly.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把農場動物畫得很生動。

items.exampleEn: The window is stuck; I can't open it.
The lake was completely motionless in the early morning.
items.exampleZh: 清晨的湖面完全靜止不動。

items.exampleEn: Something moved in the shadowy corner of the room.
items.exampleZh: 房間陰暗的角落裡有東西在動。

items.sentenceEn: My key got stuck in the lock.

items.audioEn: The damaged books in the library will be fixed next week.
items.audioZh: 圖書館裡損壞的書下週會修好。
options: The library will close for a month.
Some old books will be repaired.

items.sentenceEn: The little cat was stuck in the tree.
The cat sat motionless, watching the bird.
items.sentenceZh: 貓一動也不動地坐著，盯著那隻鳥。

items.stemEn: The truck was going ____ fast around the corner.
items.stemZh: 那輛卡車以危險的速度轉彎。

items.stemEn: The ____ bridge must be repaired before cars can use it again.
items.stemZh: 那座受損的橋必須修好，車子才能再使用。

items.passageEn: Last winter, my dad and I drove home late at night. The fog was dangerously thick. On a shadowy country road, we saw a damaged truck by the road, and there was a noticeable smell of oil. A man stood motionless next to it. My dad stopped to help. The man said he was fine, but his truck was stuck in deep mud, and one door was pushed outward and couldn't close. We called for help and waited together. We had to endure the cold for a whole hour. I still vividly remember that night.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，爸爸和我深夜開車回家。霧濃得很危險。在一條陰暗的鄉間小路上，我們看到路邊有一輛受損的卡車，空氣中有一股明顯的油味。一個男人一動也不動地站在旁邊。爸爸停車下去幫忙。那個男人說他沒事，但他的卡車卡在深深的泥巴裡，有一扇車門還被往外推開、關不上。我們打電話求救，然後一起等待。我們不得不忍受寒冷整整一個小時。我到現在還鮮明地記得那一晚。

options: 自己的車陷進泥巴裡了
撞上了路邊的一輛卡車

items.promptZh: 她把那個故事講得很生動。
referenceEn: She told that story very vividly.
rubricZh: vividly 表示「生動地」，例如 describe something vividly 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 stuck 造一個句子，說說你曾經被卡住或困住的經驗。
referenceEn: I was stuck in traffic for two hours last Friday.
My bag got stuck in the bus door.
rubricZh: stuck 表示「卡住的、困住的」，例如 get stuck 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
